opening.argument: The speaker opens by saying the video will show viewers how to use Facebook on a mobile device, then explains familiar functions such as chatting with online friends and managing app and privacy settings. The demonstration also covers navigating the news feed and menu, uploading photos, checking in, and writing a status post. Its stated purpose is to show how mobile use provides functionality comparable to Facebook on a desktop while on the go. These are ordinary social and operational features. Nothing in the described presentation solicits money or private credentials, or promises an off-platform benefit.

citations.quote: I'm going to show you how to use Facebook on a mobile device.
The button on the far right is going to allow you to chat with friends that are online.
you can set your interest, your settings, the app settings, set your favorites, set your privacy settings.
The reason you'd want Facebook on your mobile device is so that you have the same functionality a Facebook has on a desktop except it's while you're on the go.
